module.name: spans
module.short: Memory spans: views of a contiguous range of an array or string without copying.

descr.p: A span is a pointer and a length (Data, Length) that refers to a contiguous range of elements of a static array, a dynamic array, a string or TBytes. Creating a span, slicing it or splitting it into chunks does not copy elements and does not allocate memory.

Index and range checks are always performed and raise ERangeError. They do not depend on -Cr: the code of a generic is compiled with the settings of the unit that declares it. Iterating with for..in and the Data pointer give unchecked access.

A span does not own its elements and does not keep the source alive. It must not be used after the source array is freed or resized, or after the source string is modified; a span of a temporary value (a function result, an array constructor) is invalid after the statement.
Spans that do not overlap, such as different Chunks of one span, can be used from different threads at the same time without synchronization.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan
element.short: Read-only view of Length elements starting at Data.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.PT
element.short: Pointer to an element.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.TElementArray
element.short: Dynamic array of elements, as returned by ToArray.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.TEnumerator
element.short: Enumerator for for..in; it does not perform index checks.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.TEnumerator.MoveNext
element.short: Advances to the next element; False after the last one.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.TEnumerator.Current
element.short: The current element.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Create
element.short: Creates a span of a whole array, a range of an array, or ALength elements at AData.

descr.p: The overloads with an array accept static and dynamic arrays (open array parameter; the elements are not copied). The range overload raises ERangeError if AStart..AStart+ACount-1 is not inside the array. The pointer overload does not check its source: AData must point to at least ALength valid elements; a negative ALength raises ERangeError.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Slice
element.short: Returns the sub-span AStart..AStart+ACount-1 (or AStart to the end).

descr.p: Raises ERangeError if the range is not inside the span. A slice at the end with a count of 0 is empty and valid.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Chunk
element.short: Returns part AIndex of ACount nearly equal, non-overlapping parts.

descr.p: The parts are consecutive, do not overlap, together cover the whole span and differ in length by at most one element (the first Length mod ACount parts are one element longer). If ACount is greater than Length, some parts are empty. Raises ERangeError if ACount <= 0 or AIndex is not in 0..ACount-1.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.ToArray
element.short: Copies the elements into a new dynamic array.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.IsEmpty
element.short: True if Length is 0.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Overlaps
element.short: True if the two spans share at least one element.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.GetEnumerator
element.short: Returns the enumerator for for..in.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Data
element.short: Pointer to the first element (nil for an empty span of an empty array).

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Length
element.short: Number of elements.

element.name: TReadOnlySpan.Items
element.short: Element at AIndex (0-based); raises ERangeError outside 0..Length-1.

element.name: TSpan
element.short: Read/write view of Length elements starting at Data.

descr.p: Converts implicitly to TReadOnlySpan, so a TSpan can be passed where a read-only span is expected.

element.name: TSpan.PT
element.short: Pointer to an element.

element.name: TSpan.TReadOnly
element.short: The TReadOnlySpan specialization with the same element type.

element.name: TSpan.TElementArray
element.short: Dynamic array of elements, as returned by ToArray.

element.name: TSpan.TEnumerator
element.short: Enumerator for for..in (that of TReadOnly).

element.name: TSpan.Create
element.short: Creates a span of a whole array, a range of an array, or ALength elements at AData.

descr.p: Like TReadOnlySpan.Create; the array is passed as var parameter, so writes through the span change the array.

element.name: TSpan.assign(TSpan):TReadOnly
element.short: Converts to a read-only span of the same elements.

element.name: TSpan.AsReadOnly
element.short: Returns a read-only span of the same elements.

element.name: TSpan.Slice
element.short: Returns the sub-span AStart..AStart+ACount-1 (or AStart to the end).

element.name: TSpan.Chunk
element.short: Returns part AIndex of ACount nearly equal, non-overlapping parts.

element.name: TSpan.CopyFrom
element.short: Copies ASource to the start of this span.

descr.p: Raises ERangeError if ASource is longer than this span. Overlapping spans are handled (the copy is done backwards when needed). Elements are assigned one by one, so managed element types keep correct reference counts.

element.name: TSpan.Fill
element.short: Assigns AValue to all elements.

element.name: TSpan.ToArray
element.short: Copies the elements into a new dynamic array.

element.name: TSpan.IsEmpty
element.short: True if Length is 0.

element.name: TSpan.Overlaps
element.short: True if the two spans share at least one element.

element.name: TSpan.GetEnumerator
element.short: Returns the enumerator for for..in.

element.name: TSpan.Data
element.short: Pointer to the first element.

element.name: TSpan.Length
element.short: Number of elements.

element.name: TSpan.Items
element.short: Element at AIndex (0-based); raises ERangeError outside 0..Length-1.

element.name: TAnsiCharSpan
element.short: Read/write span of AnsiChar.

element.name: TReadOnlyAnsiCharSpan
element.short: Read-only span of AnsiChar.

element.name: TWideCharSpan
element.short: Read/write span of WideChar.

element.name: TReadOnlyWideCharSpan
element.short: Read-only span of WideChar.

element.name: TByteSpan
element.short: Read/write span of Byte (for TBytes).

element.name: TReadOnlyByteSpan
element.short: Read-only span of Byte (for TBytes).

element.name: SpanOf
element.short: Read-only span of the characters of a string (without the terminating #0).

descr.p: The span becomes invalid when the string is modified or freed.

element.name: MutableSpanOf
element.short: Writable span of the characters of a string.

descr.p: Makes the string unique first (UniqueString), so that writing through the span does not change other references to the same string data.
